description: The file defines the class 'PreAuthenticatedAuthenticationProvider' which handles pre-authentication logic in a security context, using specific HTTP headers to authenticate requests in a gateway security module.

classes.name: PreAuthenticatedAuthenticationProvider
classes.description: A singleton class that provides pre-authentication logic by inspecting HTTP headers and request parameters to determine authentication status and authorization context in a security gateway.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the provider.

methods.name: isApplicable
methods.description: Determines if the provider should handle the current request based on the presence of specific headers.

methods.name: tryToAuthenticate
methods.description: Attempts to authenticate the request based on pre-authentication headers or parameters, returning a future result.

methods.name: getPreAuthenticated
methods.description: Retrieves the pre-authenticated subject from headers or query parameters.

methods.name: toFailedAuthenticationResult
methods.description: Creates a failed authentication result based on an exception.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the authorization context type for the request.
